_doc: Vụ Ẩn Môn signature items (rules-proposals R7). Unpriced proposals; modifier sizes follow the wood and water catalogues' grade 3 items. Prefix va-. No set.

items.name: Mist-Lock Lantern (Tỏa Vụ Đăng)

effects.name: The Mist Does Not Ask (Vụ Bất Vấn)
effects.rule: While you stand inside your own mist field, your mist does not fade; if you leave it, it fades twice as fast.

items.lore: A pole-lantern of horn panes and black pine, the first mist lantern, hung by Hàm Thủ Lộ at the Trà Viên crossroads in 1050 (N-vu_an-01). In 1146 it was found burning on the road by empty Đồng Sơn Trấn, and nothing else of him was (N-vu_an-03). Bàng Yên Tỏa carries it. Hàm Thanh Đăng, the founder's daughter, wants it.
items.build_use: Holds the Mist-Lock field steady and keeps its keeper hard to hit.

items.name: Bobtail Axe (Đoản Vĩ Phủ)

effects.name: Out of the Mist (Xuất Vụ)
effects.rule: Your first hit after leaving a mist field strikes 20 % harder. By the sect's rule it is never struck from inside the mist.

items.lore: A woodsman's axe re-hafted in lynx-bone, carried by the robbers of Đoản Vĩ Cương (1043). Its owner brought it with him when the founder hid him from Thúy Vi's patrol in 1081 (N-vu_an-02). It has killed men on both sides of the law.
items.build_use: The road captain's: hits hard coming out of the mist and stands in the road.

items.name: Milestone Flag (Lý Bia Kỳ)
items.lore: A grey road-flag painted with the same mist seal as the milestones; set in the ground, it is one more pin of the array.
items.build_use: Holding a mist field: evasion and linh lực.

sets.name: Road Mist (Lộ Vụ)

bonuses.effect: Nobody Looked (Vô Nhân Cố): while your mist formation holds, the first art aimed at you every 8 s misses; when you leave the field, the mist holds 3 s longer.

sets.story: The lantern found burning on the road in 1146 and the flag he painted that night: the cape roads' mist in two things a carrier can hold.
